entities.summary: Christianization, a notable figure in the history of Philippines, associated with Spanish Colonization (1571–1762). Preceded by Miguel López de Legazpi establishes Manila as the colonial capital and Manila-Acapulco Galleon trade operates for 250 years. Their legacy influenced Chinese Sangley uprising in Manila brutally suppressed and José Rizal publishes Noli Me Tangere, galvanizing the reform movement.
